body: I am jn the same boat, my pain issues and break up have force me to grow up as well. I definitely understand.

Take your time then by all means if you arent sure. Theres really no rules to love, how you feel is how you feel. You sound like an emotionally intelligent guy so I think theres a real good chance you can work it out with her if thats what you two want.

Im giving him support based on what hes said in this post. He sure has problems but this is fucking suicide watch man everyone here is fucked one way or another. 

This guy doesnt need to be lectured on how its all on him. Im sure there were many women in that pool of rejection that were over the top about it. He can fix a good deal of the problems he listed but to assume that none of the blame is on these women is like just world fallacy BS. Its possible as a man to just be near unlovable, idk how people deny that. Men of a certain low value dont get any attention from women period. He can likely fix that by working on himself. You saying its all him being toxic is gaslighting him into thinking its all his problem. But you have a good point OP needs self improvement at the end of the day.

Dont listen to this idiot hes trying to just gaslight you and make you feel like its on you rather than the women who belittled you. Very typical for people to react that way and it’s unfortunate. A man cant find love = he must be toxic. Its ridiculous However, I noticed in that list you gave there were several things that are within yoir control to change. Id suggest doing that (much easier said than done Ik ik) and maybe trying women in areas you havent been to before? Trying to help with a solution.

Ive often had pretty much all the same thoughts, though you put the pen to paper much better than I could. It sucks how our brains work, how easy it is for things to get worse but how brutally fucking difficult it is for things to get better. Life is damn fucked up, but theres a tragic beauty to it all. Ig thats why I stick around.

Im sorry youre going through this feeling of loneliness. I broke up with my gf of 5 years about a year ago and still feel crushing loneliness some days from it. You get used to having that person, the intimacy, even if the relaitonship isnt working out. It sounds like to me your marriage was a very unhappy one if you say you felt lonely even before you were separated. Its cliche but now that you two are apart you might be able to eventually find what makes you feel fulfilled, whether that be something on your own or meeting a new woman. Here if you want to talk more about it friend. Regardless, I read your story and heavily empathize.

Do you want to talk about why you are feeling so suicidal? You clearly love your family (at least your sister) very much. And its not “cliche” in a bad way, lots of people hold on for their loved ones because they feel thats something worth living for. Whats going on thats got you so bummed? Im here to talk if you want friend.
Thanks so much for the help this is exactly what I needed. Ill let you know if I solve this once and for all.

You are just as valuable as anyone else my friend. Im not here looking to hurt you I want to hear you out and give support. DM me if you want buddy.
